mentions.note: won indoor half-decathlon at Cosford, 27 January 1973, 3453 pts
pictured in a crouched start on the back cover
won both hurdle races (15.9 and 56.0) and 4th in 100m final (10.9) at Barbados National Championships; 10.7 in heat equalling club record
"Snowy"; won 100m 11.3 (equalling Championship Best), shot 13.74m (pb) and discus 34.74m; just back from Barbados
completed the Blackstaffe Shield course the previous year
Life Member; won V45 HJ, PV and DT at Sheffield Veteran Games

share.d: "Snowy" Brooks in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1973–1991: 8 mentions in 6 issues, 1 race result and 1 photograph.
